standard.name: MIMAG (Minimum Information about a Metagenome-Assembled Genome)
standard.abstract: Metadata fields describing genomes derived from single-cell amplified genomes (SAGs) or metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs). The standard covers assembly/annotation software, assembly quality classifications, completeness and contamination scores and methods, single-cell (SAG) and binning (MAG)–specific metadata such as cell isolation, lysis and whole genome amplification approaches, binning parameters and software. Data are recorded as structured metadata values (controlled vocabularies, enumerations, numeric values and software/tool names).

classification.rationale: Source material is an Excel spreadsheet with explicit named metadata fields, definitions, and controlled vocabularies/possible values for each field (a genuine metadata table), not prose guidance or an ordered workflow.

assembly_quality.name: assembly quaility
assembly_quality.descr: Assembly quality category (Finished, High Quality Draft, Medium Quality Draft, Low Quality Draft) with criteria for each category.
assembly_quality.evidence: assembly quaility	Finished: Single, validated, contiguous sequence per replicon without gaps or ambiguities with a consensus error rate equivalent to Q50 or better. Assembly statistics*. 	High Quality Draft:Multiple fragments where gaps span repetitive regions. Assembly statistics*. Presence of the 23S, 16S and 5S rRNA genes and at least 18 tRNAs. 	Medium Quality Draft:Many fragments with little to no review of assembly other than reporting of standard assembly statistics*. 	Low Quality Draft:Many fragments with little to no review of assembly other than reporting of standard assembly statistics*.
